data.body: AC amendment (gap G1): Make report_schema_drift PUBLIC (drop the underscore). It is load-bearing for T4's same-pass signal routing. T1 exposes `report_schema_drift(issue_key, reason, *, repo_root, ticket_cli, alert_store)` as a public module-level function. The 'narrow seam' (Security Considerations) is preserved by keeping the function self-contained — callers (reconcile.py) supply only orchestrator-shaped state THEY ALREADY HAVE; the function itself does not import the orchestrator.
